insights8.001: 📦 Return ke raaste ka waqt ({0}): courier wale returned ya 10 din se zyada purane shipped parcel nahi mile. ("mark N shipped" aur "mark N returned" likhne se waqt banta hai.)
insights8.003: 🚚 Shehron ka muqabla ({0}): shehar wale bheje hue orders nahi mile. Shehar likhne ke liye: "Sara ki city Karachi".
insights8.005: ✅ Pichle {0} din mein koi parcel wapas nahi aaya (ya bhej kar cancel nahi hua).
insights8.007: ✅ Pichle {0} din mein koi paid (ya advance wala) order cancel / return nahi hua.
insights8.009: 🎟️ Discount aur order ka size ({0}): is dauran koi order nahi.
insights8.010: 🎟️ Discount aur order ka size ({0}): kisi category mein discount wale aur bina discount wale kam az kam 3-3 orders nahi — muqabla nahi ban saka.
insights8.012: ↩️ Discount aur return ({0}): muqabla ke liye dono qisam ke bheje gaye orders chahiye — discount wale {1}, baqi {2}.
insights8.014: Pichle 3 mahine mein kiraya, bijli ya supplier ki payment ke kharche darj nahi. Likhein, jaise: "expense 40000 kiraya", "expense 12000 bijli", "expense 150000 supplier".
insights8.016: ⏱️ Paisa kitne din mein mila ({0}): koi paid order nahi.
insights8.018: 💳 Advance aur order ka size ({0}): dono qisam ke orders chahiye — advance/wallet {1}, COD {2}.
insights8.020: ✅ Pichle {0} din mein koi cancel, return ya kharab maal nahi.
